content: Hello! This is Jamie from the school enrollment office. How can I assist you with your records today?
Hi Jamie, I wanted to update my child's information for the upcoming semester.
Sure, I can help with that. Could you please provide your child's full name and date of birth to start?
Of course. Her name is Mia Harper, and she was born on March 12, 2012.
Thank you. Can you also confirm your current home address, including zip code?
Yes, we live at 742 Evergreen Terrace, Springfield, 62704.
Got it. Lastly, could you provide a contact phone number and your relationship to Mia, just to confirm your authorization?
My phone number is (555) 123-7890, and I'm her mother.
Perfect. I've updated Mia's records with the new information. If you need any further assistance, feel free to reach out.
